Doors 21:00 · Room 4Doors 21:00 · Room 4

The display faces have no figures worth setting small; times and rooms go in the text face.
Signature
Two layers of one sign system stacked in register: the solid cut in the accent below, nudged 0.05 em down and right, the inline face in light on top, offset by nothing. It reads like a painted shop sign at night.
Use when
Bars, arcades, venues, food trucks, street festivals, playful product launches that want a sign rather than a slogan.
Turns into slop when
When the layers drift out of register, when more than one sign appears per screen, when it sets a sentence, or when neon glow is added on top.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
